items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: I played with Kid Rene's band. He was playing Rene's band at the time. Joe Rene's playing. I used to play sometimes.

ctx.x: Did you play with him in the old days?
I played with Kid Rene's band. He was playing Rene's band at the time. Joe Rene's playing. I used to play sometimes. Joe couldn't play and I played sometimes.
Who else was in Rene's band?
